title: Unfair contract terms protection extended to small business
summary: Unfair contract term protections in the ACL and ASIC Act were extended to standard form small business contracts (party with fewer than 20 employees, under value thresholds) entered or renewed from 12 November 2016.

instruments.title: Treasury Legislation Amendment (Small Business and Unfair Contract Terms) Act 2015

commenced.what: Schedule 1 (UCT for small business contracts) commenced

direction_rationale: Voidable unfair terms reduce the ability of larger firms to impose one-sided terms on small suppliers, franchisees and customers, improving small firms' ability to compete and survive.

assessment.summary: Unfair terms in standard form contracts with small businesses became void. It curbs one-sided terms that larger firms impose on small suppliers, franchisees and customers.

marks.reason: Limits larger firms' ability to impose one-sided terms on small businesses.

responsible.note: Administers the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (except Parts given to other Ministers).

history.what: Unfair contract terms made illegal, with penalties, and small business protection widened.
